overview: Braddicks is a seafront holiday park in Westward Ho!, with the two-mile sandy beach right alongside. It offers a mix of self-catering holiday homes, caravans, villas, chalets and apartments, many with sea views, including units adapted for limited mobility. On site there is a bar, a games room and The Pier House restaurant, and parking is free.
surfTripFit: Its seafront position makes it easy to check the surf and walk down to the beach at Westward Ho!.
